head.note: Face/head disc incl. stripes, cheeks and pinkish bottom band; bottom = colour edge of the band vs collar brown / background / tail; top/ear junctions = AI-continued head outline (ai_no_ears).

tuft.note: Cowlick blobs protruding above the AI-continued head outline + their soft lower-blob shading over the head; head stripes stay head. Merge into head if a separate tuft is not wanted.

earL.note: Viewer-left ear: original pixels outside the head outline continued by ai_no_ears (cut runs notch-to-notch along the head arc).

earR.note: Viewer-right ear: same rule as earL.

torso.note: Body incl. collar band, collar shadow over chest, belly, pendant glow, crotch shading band; bounded by arm wedge edges, hip cuts, tail mask.

pendant.note: Acorn only (olive cap+stem, green nut, highlights) by colour in pendant window, holes filled; glow stays torso.

armL.note: Torso-side edge of the dark inner-arm shading wedge (measured per row), continued straight up to the collar; collar brown excluded, shoulder collar-shadow included.

armR.note: Mirror of armL; separated from the tail by the AI tail mask (arm keeps its underside shading band, as in ai_no_tail).

legL.note: Hip cut: line from outer silhouette (y=880) to inner-thigh shading tip (421,887), along shading top edge to the leg gap (470,900), then down the gap edge.

legR.note: Mirror of legL: (604,887) -> (556,900) -> gap edge; right outer side bounded by the tail mask.

tail.note: Pixels changed by ai_no_tail AND non-green in ai_tail_only; includes the small dark stripe triangle visible between right arm and torso (joined to the main tail by its shading).
